title: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.

claims.claim: Tau Robotics is a startup that sends humanoid robots to clean San Francisco homes.

evidence.quote: The startup Tau Robotics is sending humanoid robots to clean San Francisco homes.

claims.claim: The robots are currently piloted remotely by humans watching via cameras mounted in the robots' heads and wrists.

evidence.quote: For now, the robots are piloted remotely by humans, who watch what’s going on via cameras mounted in the robots’ heads and wrists.

claims.claim: Tau initially offered $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot.

evidence.quote: At the time I booked, Tau was offering $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot

claims.claim: Tau's current charges are $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots or $100 for a one-time visit.

evidence.quote: now the charge is $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots, or $100 for a one-time visit.

claims.claim: Each robot stands four-and-a-half feet tall and is equipped with a 3D-printed head and claw hands.

evidence.quote: Tau has armed each four-and-a-half-foot-tall robot with a 3D-printed “head” with antennae that allow it to communicate with Tau’s headquarters, as well as two 3D-printed claw “hands”

claims.claim: According to cofounder Cornelia Weinzierl, the robot can already complete tasks like vacuuming and mopping without human help.

evidence.quote: But according to Tau cofounder Cornelia Weinzierl, to whom I came clean as a journalist a few weeks after the cleaning, the robot can already complete some other tasks—such as vacuuming and mopping—without any human help.

claims.claim: The robot arrived at the author's building in a blue minivan.

evidence.quote: It arrived in a blue minivan, out of which it was helped by Weinzierl and another Tau employee.
The cleaning robot that came to my building last month was already a bit of a spectacle. It arrived in a blue minivan, out of which it was helped by Weinzierl and another Tau employee.

claims.claim: Tau Robotics has completed only a couple hundred cleanings so far.

evidence.quote: and the company has completed only a couple hundred cleanings so far.
the company has completed only a couple hundred cleanings so far.
